map.哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表（Columbia Suicide Severity: Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) assesses severity of suicidal ideation and behavior
map.C-SSRS自杀风险：按意念条目取最高等级（0无→5具体计划+意图），行为条目分: C-SSRS suicide risk: take the highest level among ideation items (0 none to 5 specific plan + intent) and grade behavior items; higher level means higher risk requiring urgent intervention.
map.警告：本工具仅供专业人员筛查参考: Warning: this tool is for professional screening reference only

map.本工具基于 C-SSRS 简版筛查量表，纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器: This tool runs on the brief C-SSRS screen entirely in your browser; data is never uploaded to any server
map.C-SSRS 是广泛应用于临床和科研的心理危机风险评估工具，由哥伦比亚大学开发: C-SSRS is a widely used clinical and research crisis-risk assessment tool developed by Columbia University
map.危机意念部分从 1-5 级递增，最高\"是\"的选项决定意念严重程度: The ideation section rises from level 1 to 5; the highest 'yes' option determines ideation severity
map.危机行为部分若近 3 个月内有任何\"是\"，提示高风险，需立即干预: For behavior, any 'yes' within the past 3 months indicates high risk requiring immediate intervention
map.本工具仅供专业人员参考，不替代专业精神科诊断和临床判断: This tool is for professional reference only and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis or clinical judgment
map.意念 5 级连续「是」至第 3 级，行为 4 项（近期尝试/准备/非自杀自伤/实: Ideation positive through level 3 of 5, with all 4 behavior items (recent attempt / preparation / non-suicidal self-injury / actual attempt) negative -> moderate risk; prompt professional involvement advised.
map.行为第 4 项「实际尝试=是」且近 3 月内 → 高危，立即危机干预。: Behavior item 4 'actual attempt = yes' within the past 3 months -> high risk; immediate crisis intervention.
map.本页为专业人员评分式（assessor，半结构化提问），cssrs-suicid: This page is the professional-rated version (assessor, semi-structured); cssrs-suicide is self-rated. Both share the same risk-stratification logic; general users should prefer the self-report version.
map.应由受训者按半结构化提问完成，结果用于分诊与监护决策。: It should be completed by a trained rater via semi-structured questioning; results inform triage and monitoring decisions.
map.本工具基于哥伦比亚大学 C-SSRS 量表，用于筛查心理危机与自杀意念风险。量表: This tool is based on Columbia University's C-SSRS for screening psychological crisis and suicidal-ideation risk. It assesses suicidal ideation (5-level progression) and suicidal behavior (actual attempt / preparation / self-injury), auto-grades risk level and gives clinical advice.
map.C-SSRS 国际标准化心理危机风险评估量表: C-SSRS: an international standardized crisis-risk assessment scale
map.自杀意念5级递进评估（被动意念→具体计划）: Five-level progressive ideation assessment (passive wish to specific plan)
map.自杀行为与非自杀性自伤区分评估: Distinguishes suicidal behavior from non-suicidal self-injury
map.自动风险分级与临床干预建议: Automatic risk grading with clinical intervention advice
map.精神科门诊心理危机风险初筛: Initial crisis-risk screening in psychiatric outpatient clinics
